items.title: No Surprises Act system managers eject two umpires - BenefitsPRO
items.reason: This item directly addresses enforcement and operational management of the No Surprises Act's Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process, specifically removal of IDR umpires, which constitutes a material development in NSA implementation.
items.summary: The No Surprises Act system managers have removed two Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) umpires from the federal program that resolves payment disputes between insurers and healthcare providers. This action affects the IDR process, a core mechanism under the No Surprises Act for resolving out-of-network balance billing disputes. The removal of umpires could impact the efficiency and capacity of the IDR system to process disputes, which is relevant to revenue-cycle teams managing claim denials and out-of-network payment recovery.
